sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Ringing and buzzing. Cracking in left ear
with headache. Parts around ear feel swollen. Polypi.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Constant pressure at the cardiac end of
the stomach, and a burning pain there. Nausea, with
headache, and vomiting of yellowish bitter mucus.
Pains shift from stomach to vertex.

Abdomen and Stool. — In the morning, difficult pas-
sages of small quantities of flatus; afterwards diar-
rhoea-like urging in the rectum. Pain in bowels before

sections.label: stool
sections.text:
Severe pain in the bowels; with shuddering chil-
liness. Constriction in the anus.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Bloody, albuminous, with much urging;
quantities of urates.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Hoarseness, with dry, sore throat ;
cough worse at night, with aching in forehead and con-
strictive pain in chest; pleuritic pains.

Sexual. — Seminal emissions; weakness. “Slothful
to venery.”

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Rheumatic pains; stiff and contracted
joints. Muscles feel strained and torn from their at-
tachment. Weakness of lower extremities. Paraplegia.
Pain in hips. Rheumatism comes on with suddenness
and restlessness. Sweat does not relieve.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Red, itching and burning. Nettle-rash. Nodes
around joints. [Ammon, phos.] Profuse sweat with-
out relief.

sections.label: Modalities
sections.text:
Worse, cold and cold washing, before a
snowstorm. Better, warmth, pressure, rubbing. Comb-
ing hair.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare : Formic acid. Chr 9 nic
myalgia Muscular pains and soreness. Gout and ar-
ticular rheumatism, which appear suddenly. Pains usu-
ally worse on right side, motion and better from pres-
sure. Failing vision. (Increases muscular strength and
resistance to fatigue. Feels stronger and more “fit” in
ordinary walking. Marked diuretic effect, greater
elimination of products of disassimilation, particularly
urea). Tremor. Tuberculosis, chronic nephritis and
carcinoma, lupus, etc., have been treated successfully
with injections of Formic acid of a dilution correspond-
ing to the 3d and 4th centesimal. In prescribing it for
varicose veins, polypi, catarrh. Dr. J. H. Clarke orders
an ounce or two of a solution of Formic acid in the
proportion of one part of the acid to eleven of distilled
water. Of this one teaspoonful is taken in a table-
spoonful of water after food once or twice daily. Pam
in aponeurosis and rfluscles of head, neck and shoulders
before a snowstorm. Fhu^' (llulrnm Jlrtica and /mwj-
perus contain Formic acid). Calc, fluor.
